speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing right groin pain and have had trouble positioning your leg following a rear-end collision. To ensure your safety and determine the extent of the injury, can you tell me exactly what happened during the accident and how long ago it occurred?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acetabular Fracture

Given the mechanism of injury (rear-end collision as a restrained passenger) and the specific location of severe right groin pain, I am concerned about an acetabular fracture. Can you tell me if you felt a distinct "pop" or heard a cracking sound at the time of the accident, and does moving your leg cause sharp pain? Also, are you currently able to bear any weight on that leg?
